select * from ( select concat('reply-', ar.id) as id, 'reply' as type, '帖子收到新回复' as title, ar.content, ar.articleId, a.title as articleTitle, ar.createTime, u.id as u_id, u.avatarUrl as u_avatarUrl, u.nickname as u_nickname, u.username as u_username, u.gender as u_gender from t_article_reply ar inner join t_article a on ar.articleId = a.id inner join t_user u on ar.postUserId = u.id where a.userId = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and ar.postUserId != #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and ar.deleteState = 0 and a.deleteState = 0
union all
select concat('like-', al.id), 'like', '帖子收到新点赞', '赞了你的帖子', al.articleId, a.title, al.createTime, u.id, u.avatarUrl, u.nickname, u.username, u.gender from t_article_like al inner join t_article a on al.articleId = a.id inner join t_user u on al.userId = u.id where a.userId = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and al.userId != #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.deleteState = 0
union all
select concat('collect-', ac.id), 'collect', '帖子被收藏', '收藏了你的帖子', ac.articleId, a.title, ac.createTime, u.id, u.avatarUrl, u.nickname, u.username, u.gender from t_article_collect ac inner join t_article a on ac.articleId = a.id inner join t_user u on ac.userId = u.id where a.userId = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and ac.userId != #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.deleteState = 0
union all
select concat('report-', r.id), 'report', '举报处理结果', r.handleResult, r.articleId, a.title, r.updateTime, null, null, null, null, null from t_report r inner join t_article a on r.articleId = a.id where r.reporterId = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and r.status in (1, 2) ) t order by t.createTime desc limit 0, #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}
